scripts.title: [FIXED Link 21-07-26]Universal Roblox Chat
scripts.features:
Features:
Works Everywhere – Truly universal; use it in any game you want.

Smart UI – Automatically detects if you are on Mobile or PC and adjusts the size perfectly.

Mobile Support – Optimized touch controls and custom "Tap to Chat" placeholder for mobile users.

Auto-Translation Engine – Real-time detection of incoming messages with toggleable auto-translate to your local language using /toggle and /lang [ISO].

Built-in Command Menu – Use /commands to see the full list of available features, shortcuts, and settings instantly.

Custom Color System – Use /color [name] to change your chat and bubble color instantly with high-quality hex syncing.

Bubble Chat – Full TextChatService integration. Messages show up over your head with RichText color support.

Echo & Delay – Use /echo [1-60s] [msg] for timed messages, or /clearecho to cancel them instantly.

Authentic Colors – Usernames use the official Roblox algorithm for unique, recognizable colors.

Translated Alerts – Get a "Joined Channel" notification in your own language as soon as you connect.

Lag Free – Optimized message logging and smooth scrolling to keep your game running fast.

Copy Feature – Just click the "Copy" button next to any message to grab the text instantly.

Clear Chat – A big, easy button to wipe the log whenever it gets too full.

Slash To Talk – Hit '/' to start typing on PC, exactly like the standard Roblox chat.
*Note:* I tested this script in this game, https://www.roblox.com/games/123974602339071/Just-a-baseplate
*Additional Note:* 
This only works when other players have the script executed. For example, if Player 1 and Player 2 both have the script, they can see each other's chat, but nobody else in the server will see it.
